# Other Details | DougSpeed.com

## Main Content

This page serves as a navigation hub for detailed technical documentation about LDAK (a genetic analysis software). The page presents organized links to comprehensive guides covering:

**Data & Formats:**
- 1000 Genomes Project data usage for ancestry inference
- File format specifications for genetic data
- Phenotype and covariate file formatting
- Summary statistics formatting guidelines
- Kinship matrix storage formats

**Data Management:**
- Data filtering and subsetting procedures
- Sample subset specifications
- Quality control protocols
- High-LD region identification

**Advanced Configuration:**
- Working directory and random seed settings
- Reference panel construction guidelines
- Relatives file specifications
- Relatives filtering methods

**Quality Assurance:**
- Data cleaning best practices
- Inflation detection procedures

The page includes a site footer with WordPress attribution and the tagline "LDAK: it's better" alongside a Dalek image reference.
